hooks.command: case "$(ps -o args= -p $PPID 2>/dev/null)" in *--team-name*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; [ -n "$ITERM_SESSION_ID" ] || exit 0; it2bin=$(command -v it2 || echo /Applications/iTerm.app/Contents/Resources/utilities/it2); [ -x "$it2bin" ] || exit 0; "$it2bin" session close --session "${ITERM_SESSION_ID#*:}" --force >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
